sentences.text: A mindset is how you think.
The first mindset is a fixed mindset.
People with a fixed mindset think things are permanent.
They think, “I am good at math.”
Or they think, “I am bad at math.”
A hard question is a big problem.
The second mindset is a growth mindset.
People with a growth mindset think they can learn.
They think, “I am not good at math now.
A mistake is a chance to learn.
A hard question is not a problem.
With a fixed mindset, you think, “This is too hard.
With a growth mindset, you think, “This is new.
A growth mindset is a happy mindset.
It is a good way to think.
You are not afraid of new things.
